aurum.settings.title: Aurum
aurum.settings.phase_note: Version %s. Water and POM arrive in later phases.
aurum.preset.tooltip: Low holds 60 FPS on integrated graphics. High adds POM and a larger shadow map. Moving any single option switches to Custom.
aurum.option.sky_enabled.tooltip: Replaces the vanilla sky with the golden-hour sky.
aurum.option.sunset_intensity.tooltip: How strong the orange band at dawn and dusk is.
aurum.option.horizon_warmth.tooltip: Warmth of the horizon glow toward the sun.
aurum.option.rain_desaturation.tooltip: How much rain pulls the sky toward grey.
aurum.option.lighting_enabled.tooltip: Sun light, sky ambient and warmed block light on terrain.
aurum.option.sun_strength.tooltip: Strength of direct sun and moon light.
aurum.option.ambient_strength.tooltip: Strength of the sky-tinted ambient light in shade.
aurum.option.block_light_warmth.tooltip: How warm torches and lamps look.
aurum.option.ao_boost.tooltip: Extra depth on top of vanilla smooth lighting.
aurum.option.normals_enabled.tooltip: Bump detail baked from block textures at load. One texture read per pixel.
aurum.option.normal_strength.tooltip: Depth of the generated bump detail.
aurum.option.labpbr.tooltip:
Use _n and _s textures from a LabPBR resource pack when one is loaded.
§7Arrives in Phase 5.
aurum.option.bounce_enabled.tooltip: Tints shade and fog with the colour around you: warm in Badlands, blue on snow.
aurum.option.bounce_strength.tooltip: How strongly the surroundings colour the shade.
aurum.option.bloom_enabled.tooltip: Soft glow around the sun, lava and bright highlights.
aurum.option.sheen_enabled.tooltip:
Soft highlight on sand, terracotta, polished stone, ice and glass at low sun.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.sheen_strength.tooltip:
Brightness of the material sheen.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.shadows_enabled.tooltip: Real shadows from the sun and moon. The most expensive effect.
aurum.option.shadow_resolution.tooltip: Sharper shadows at higher sizes. 1024 on Low. Medium and High also use softer 8-tap edges.
aurum.option.shadow_distance.tooltip: Shadows are drawn this far around you, then fade. Further costs more when the shadow map updates.
aurum.option.shadow_softness.tooltip: Width of the soft shadow edge.
aurum.option.entity_shadows.tooltip: Real shadows for players and mobs within 16 blocks, redrawn every frame. Costs some CPU; off on Low.
aurum.option.blob_shadows.tooltip: Mobs further than 16 blocks keep Minecraft's soft round shadow (uses the vanilla Entity Shadows video option).
aurum.option.fog_enabled.tooltip: Subtle fog that only appears at dawn, dusk, in rain, caves and swamps.
aurum.option.fog_strength.tooltip: Scales every kind of Aurum fog.
aurum.option.height_fog.tooltip: Low fog that settles in valleys.
aurum.option.edge_fade.tooltip: Light fade that hides the render distance edge.
aurum.option.water_enabled.tooltip:
Gentle water with depth colour and sky reflections.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.water_reflections.tooltip:
Water reflects the real sky, sunset and clouds.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.wave_strength.tooltip:
Height of the small surface ripples.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.vertex_waves.tooltip:
Very small real waves near you. Medium and High.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.foam.tooltip:
Soft foam along shores and around blocks.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.puddles.tooltip:
Ground gets wet and puddles form in rain, then dry over minutes.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.ground_reflections.tooltip:
Sky reflection on smooth materials.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.flare_enabled.tooltip: A subtle warm flare and faint ghosts from the sun, hidden behind terrain and clouds.
aurum.option.god_rays_enabled.tooltip: Light shafts from the sun through trees, terrain and cloud gaps. Strongest at golden hour.
aurum.option.clouds_enabled.tooltip: Soft, rounded, layered clouds (Story Mode style) in place of vanilla's. Uses the cloud shapes of your resource pack. The vanilla Clouds option set to Off turns them off too.
aurum.option.cloud_coverage.tooltip: How much of the sky the clouds cover in clear weather. 50% is vanilla.
aurum.option.cloud_shading.tooltip: How much the sun shapes the clouds: 0% flat colour, 100% lit tops and soft bellies.
aurum.option.pom_enabled.tooltip:
Carved depth on blocks close to you. High tier only.
§7Arrives in Phase 5.
aurum.option.pom_depth.tooltip:
How deep the carved detail looks.
§7Arrives in Phase 5.
aurum.option.pom_distance.tooltip:
POM fades out past this distance.
§7Arrives in Phase 5.
aurum.option.tonemap.tooltip: How bright light is mapped to the screen. Aurum Filmic keeps colours true (no yellow shift). AgX is softer and shifts bright colours toward yellow.
aurum.option.vibrance.tooltip: Boosts muted colours more than already strong ones.
aurum.option.show_overlay.tooltip: Shows the GPU time of each render stage. Costs nothing when off. Key: F8.
aurum.option.waving_enabled.tooltip: Grass, flowers, crops, leaves and vines sway in the wind. Gusts roll across the land; rain and thunder make it stronger.
aurum.option.waving_strength.tooltip: How far plants and leaves move.
aurum.option.waving_speed.tooltip: How fast plants move and gusts travel.
aurum.option.white_balance.tooltip: Makes midday light neutral white, like a camera. Lower it for a warmer, more vintage look. Sunsets stay warm either way.
